title: Investigation Step
description: One tool call made by the agent while pursuing a Lead, plus its typed decision. This is the structured-output contract from ARCHITECTURE.md §6/§9 — the frontend and orchestration code consume this, never free-text agent output. See docs/contracts/investigation.md.

reason.description: Why this tool was called now — must be answerable to a judge.

result_refs.description: IDs of records or Evidence this step produced or touched.

decision.description: FOLLOW: keep investigating this branch. DISCARD: stop, insufficient signal. ESCALATE: flag for human review. CONCLUDE: enough evidence to write the Case.
